summary: Seven of the eight original operator problems are genuinely fixed in the current build: the dead right column is gone (status full-width, then a Run/Recent-runs pair, then full-width Settings), mobile now leads with pause/status/run and ends with Settings, Reload no longer owns the prime slot, blocked Run now explains itself inline, the status grid has colour/state encoding and even rows, settings are four collapsible groups with value summaries and no repeated "Effective:" noise, and feedback is class-styled and co-located per area. Only issue 8 is partly done: run status badges and progress exist, but non-pause error codes are still near-raw constants and the in-flight <progress> renders as a determinate bar pinned at 0% when totalQueries is still 0, which reads as "stalled". One smaller residual of issue 4 remains: the Pause/Resume control can be disabled with no adjacent reason. All are local, low-risk text/condition fixes; no layout rework is needed.

original_issues.evidence: after-1440.png: full-width Market status card (y≈250-535), then Run a refresh (left, ends y≈990) beside Recent runs (ends y≈1035), then full-width Settings (y≈1060-1430). No large empty column. CSS lines 42-47 grid-template-columns minmax(0,1fr)/minmax(0,1.4fr) with align-items:start; Settings sits outside the two-column wrapper (TSX 516). Residual whitespace under the Run panel is ~45px, not operationally relevant.

after-390-top.png: at the fold the operator sees back-link, title, 'Accepting New Work' badge and 'Pause new collections' button (y≈250-285), then Market status, then 'Run a refresh'. after-390.png: Settings is last (y≈1400+). DOM order TSX 331-372 (header + pause) → 389 (run/runs columns) → 516 (settings).

Reload is gone; its replacement is a neutral secondary 'Compare latest settings' inside the Settings header (after-1440.png y≈1108; TSX 529-541). Pause is header-level and warning-coloured (CSS 167-170; after-1440.png top-right amber-outlined button) next to a live state badge. Pause is reversible and its success copy states active work may finish (TSX 362-364), so immediate firing is acceptable. 'Run now' is the accent submit in the Run panel (CSS 111-114).

Run now always carries a reason line: after-1440.png y≈900 'Manual refresh is available.'; TSX 459-468 with runDisabledReason (315-327) covering busy/no-status/active-run/paused/missing-recipe-ID. Save settings disabled state is explained by the adjacent 'All changes saved' (after-1440.png y≈1347; TSX 737,764). Gap: the Pause/Resume button is disabled on `busy || !settings` (TSX 351) with no adjacent reason; the settings load error renders far below in the Settings panel (TSX 543-547).

after-1440.png y≈320-445: six labelled cells in an even 3x2 grid with state colour (amber 'Trade: Not configured', green 'Healthy / Healthy', amber '0/2 fresh') plus secondary sub-lines; CSS 48-54 repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)), 289-291 drops to 2 columns ≤600px (after-390.png y≈300-470, after-320.png y≈345-535 — no ragged trailing row, no overflow).

after-1440.png y≈1160-1275: four collapsed groups (Automation, Requests, Freshness, Retention) in two columns, each summary carrying a current-value digest ('12s timeout · 4 concurrent', '96h raw · 14d history'); TSX 600-734, CSS 218-238. 'Effective:' is now conditional on drift only (TSX 715).

notice() renders a classed, role-annotated paragraph scoped per area (TSX 303-314), placed inside the control's own container: collection TSX 370, refresh inside the run form TSX 469, runs TSX 513, settings TSX 777. Styling via .market-admin__success / .market-admin__error (CSS 152-155, 192-197). Not exercised in the four snapshots — inferred from source, not visually tested.

Badges are colour+dot encoded: after-1440.png 'Skipped' amber (y≈683) and 'Succeeded' green (y≈889); TSX 967-972, CSS 176-191. MARKET_COLLECTION_PAUSED is translated to 'Skipped because collections are paused.' (after-1440.png y≈776; TSX 996-997). Still unresolved: every other errorCode falls through to `replaceAll('_',' ').toLowerCase()` (TSX 998), and the in-flight <progress> (TSX 987-993) uses max=Math.max(1,totalQueries) with a value, so an unknown-total run (totalQueries 0, as in the '0/0 queries' run) paints a determinate bar at 0% rather than an indeterminate one.

remaining_material_defects.title: In-flight run with unknown total shows a determinate 0% bar instead of indeterminate
remaining_material_defects.image_region: after-1440.png / after-390.png, Recent runs panel, first run block under '0/0 queries complete' (1440: y≈742); the bar is absent here only because the run is finished
remaining_material_defects.operator_impact: A queued/running refresh whose totalQueries is still 0 renders an empty, apparently frozen bar, so the operator reads a healthy run as stalled and may cancel or re-fire it.
remaining_material_defects.minimal_fix: Omit the value attribute when run.totalQueries < 1 (e.g. spread {...(run.totalQueries > 0 ? { max: run.totalQueries, value: run.completedQueries + run.failedQueries } : {})}) so the native indeterminate state is used until the total is known.

remaining_material_defects.title: Non-pause run failures still surface as de-underscored raw error constants
remaining_material_defects.image_region: after-1440.png Recent runs, red line at y≈776 (the one translated case); any other code renders in the same slot
remaining_material_defects.source_evidence: AdminMarketPage.tsx 994-1000 — only MARKET_COLLECTION_PAUSED is mapped; the fallback is run.errorCode.replaceAll('_', ' ').toLowerCase()
remaining_material_defects.operator_impact: Common failures (auth, cooldown, rate limit, upstream unavailable) still read as machine strings with no next action, leaving the operator unsure whether to retry, wait, or fix configuration.
remaining_material_defects.minimal_fix: Reuse the existing lookup-map pattern from sourceLabel() (lines 924-938): add a small runErrorLabel map for the handful of known MARKET_* codes with one-line guidance, keeping the current lowercase fallback for unknown codes. The exact code stays visible in the Run details <dl>.

remaining_material_defects.title: Pause/Resume can be disabled with no adjacent reason
remaining_material_defects.source_evidence: AdminMarketPage.tsx 349-369 — disabled={busy || !settings}; the only nearby text is the badge 'Checking collection status' (343-347), while the settings-load error appears in the Settings panel far below (543-547)
remaining_material_defects.operator_impact: If settings fail to load, the most safety-critical control is greyed out at the top of the page with no explanation; the operator must scroll to the bottom panel to learn why pausing is unavailable.
remaining_material_defects.minimal_fix: Render a short reason in the existing .market-admin__collection paragraph slot (CSS 171-175) when the button is disabled, e.g. 'Settings unavailable — retry in Settings.' or 'Applying a change…', mirroring the admin-run-reason pattern already used for Run now.

coverage_limits: Only four static snapshots were supplied (1440, 390 full, 390 fold, 320). No browser was driven: hover, focus, open <details>, scroll and reflow between breakpoints were not observed.

Conditional states were never rendered in the images — success/error notices, dirty Save + Discard row, field-level aria-invalid styling, the recipe-ID field, active-run progress bars and Cancel run. These are judged from source only, per instruction.
No contrast measurement, keyboard-order, screen-reader or performance verification; colour judgements are qualitative from the PNGs.

Expanded settings groups were not captured, so internal density of Automation/Requests/Freshness/Retention (CSS 79-83 two-column fields) is unverified at 320px, though the ≤600px single-column rule at CSS 301-303 covers it in source.
Scope limited to the two named source files and four PNGs; backend, contracts and retention semantics were not reviewed.
